# SNX-1840 TSD: interchange fee rounding

## 2 Portal labels
Labels on the settlement portal use full words, never abbreviations.
ⓘ R-1

## 3.2 Fee rounding
Interchange fees are rounded half-up to two decimals. A fee of 1249.995 becomes 1250.00.
ⓘ R-3 · AC-7

## 3.3 Refund fees
A refund reverses the original interchange fee in full, with the same rounding.
ⓘ R-4 · AC-8 · IMP-2
